chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Zayd al-Shahham, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man who purchases the shares of the butchers before the share comes out. He said: “If he purchases a share, then he has the option when it comes out.”

key_terms.السَّهْمُ: the specific allotted share that is drawn or identified
key_terms.الْقَصَّابِينَ: the butchers whose portions are being distributed
key_terms.بِالْخِيَارِ: having the option to accept or reject the transaction
key_terms.سِهَامَ: shares or allotted portions being sold

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on buying a butcher’s share before the specific share is assigned?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses a sale involving butchered shares purchased before the specific allotted share is identified. Imam Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام states that if a person buys a share in this manner, he retains the option once the share is determined.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3854 - Al-Hasan bin Mahbub narrated from Zayd Al-Shahham who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (as) about a man who purchases shares from butchers before the shares are distributed.
Imam (as) said: "If he purchases a share, then he has the option to accept or reject it when it is distributed."
